question: Among human superheroes who have more than 10 superpowers and a recorded weight, find the one with the highest durability attribute value. Return their superhero name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN race AS T6 ON T1."XCL_025" = T6."XCL_016"
WHERE T6."XCL_017" = 'Human'
  AND T1."XCL_029" IS NOT NULL
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
  AND T1."XCL_018" IN (
    SELECT T2."XCL_012"
    FROM hero_power AS T2
    GROUP BY T2."XCL_012"
    HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_013") > 10
  )
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN race AS T6 ON T1."XCL_025" = T6."XCL_016"
WHERE T6."XCL_017" = 'Human'
  AND T1."XCL_029" IS NOT NULL
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Durability'
  AND T1."XCL_018" IN (
    SELECT T2."XCL_012"
    FROM hero_power AS T2
    GROUP BY T2."XCL_012"
    HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_013") > 10
  )
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
